# `company.bulk_edit_runs`

Grid edits: a selection of one list and the changes asked of it, previewed as a diff, then applied as one reversible batch. Only state, batch and version change.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this grid edit. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | List edited: customer, vendor, item or account. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | previewed, applying, applied, applied_partly (some records refused), rolled_back (all or nothing, undone at a refusal), cancelled (stopped part way, what it changed put back) or failed (that undo was refused). |
| `atomic` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | True when the first refusal undoes the whole edit. |
| `selection` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON of the records chosen: the list filter, search text or named records. |
| `operations` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON of what was asked: cell changes, pasted text and column operations, in order. |
| `label` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | What the edit does, as a person reads it. |
| `record_count` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Records selected. |
| `unchanged_count` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Selected records the edit leaves as they are (no row is stored for them). |
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | The batch its writes belong to; null until it is applied. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why, as given at preview. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of the run. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | ix_bulk_edit_runs_created | — | UTC time of the preview. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that previewed it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was previewed through. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the last state change. |
